summary: The empty trade list holds up after the close. The Proposer made no proposals, I can only approve or shrink, and the only room was about $9 above the 10% cash buffer. I rested the pass on immaterial size and a thin tape (Nasdaq rout, Apple print, midterms, NFP) and not on L4, which was what the Skeptic asked for. Cash closed near 11.4%, and the account was 88.6% invested against the shadow's 99.0%. The gap vs the shadow is mostly idle cash and sleeve choice, and this decision did little to change it. Since the version-4 start on 10-28 the agent is +2.7% against the shadow's +0.9% and SPY's -2.6%, so the idle cash did not hurt today. I am not judging the call by one day's P&L, which was +$14.91 and mostly IDXX at +21.6%. The held-position review was the useful part. IDXX: the beat and raise settled the binary risk, so I held and re-anchored. CARG: the 11-05 after-close clause stayed live. DPZ: the stale $274.88 stop, anchored to the reference close and 13% under the fill, was replaced with about $285, which ends the 9-session L1 drift, and the unverified guidance-cut item was kept as a conditional sell and not treated as fact. BTC/USD: the exchange-failure clause was correctly judged untripped. Weak points: (1) the IDXX stop of about $575 was set 10% under an intraday ~$639, but IDXX closed near $670, so the stop is now about 14% below the close and gives back most of the gain. It should be ratcheted up, for example to near $600 or to the gain-protecting level, in the next session's held-position review. (2) BTC/USD closed near $76.7k, only about 2% above the $75.3k price stop, and is -8.4% on cost with midterms tomorrow and the 11-11 MSCI/Strategy decision ahead. The stop is a mechanical trigger and nothing is broken yet, but the position is the one closest to a sell. (3) VOO plus VTI (about 22%) is near-identical US beta and both are slightly negative on cost. No change today, but it limits how much new risk a favored-sector idea can add.
lessons: When a held name gaps well past the price its stop was written against (IDXX +21.6% on the day), re-anchor the stop to the close and to the gain, not to a stale intraday level. A stop that was 10% away at the decision can be 14% away by the close.

Standing aside because of a ~$9 deployable amount is fine when the reason is stated as immaterial size and an event-heavy tape. Keep L4 for token diversification-only buys and do not cite it as a blanket reason to hold cash.

Idle cash is the main source of the lag vs the shadow (88.6% vs 99.0% invested). When cash rises after the print cluster, look for a quality or favored-sector proposal (Energy is unheld) instead of defaulting to hold again.
A price stop within about 2% of the market (BTC/USD vs $75.3k) should be named in the next decision with the dated catalysts (midterms, 11-11 MSCI), so a mechanical exit is not a surprise.

When a news item is an unverified aggregator claim (the DPZ guidance cut), write a conditional sell trigger with a numeric level, make no adds, and say it is unverified. Do not treat it as confirmed or as noise.
